Introduction

Youha is a South Korean singer-songwriter and composer under 88rising. She made her debut on September 29, 2020, with her digital single "Island".

She was first introduced as a member of the pre-debut team known as Future 2NE1 back in 2012, which was supposed to debut sometime in 2016. But for unknown reasons the debut was cancelled, so she continued the training process. She left YG Entertainment after 9 years of being a trainee under the label in 2019.

In addition to working on her own musuc, Youha has written and produced for other artists such as VICTON, LOONA, Kep1er, STAYC, TripleS, and more. She also wrote and composed songs for survival shows like My Teenage Girl and Universe Ticket.
